text: This solution, May/June 2021 Flood Repairs addresses natural catastrophe in New Zealand between National Institute of Water and Atmospheric Research (NIWA), University of Auckland, New Zealand Ministry of Business, Innovation, and Employment (MBIE) Endeavour Fund, Resilience to Nature’s Challenges National Science Challenge (RNC) Multihazard Risk Programme, Buller District Council, West Coast Regional Council, West Coast Civil Defence Emergency Management Group, Fire and Emergency New Zealand (FENZ), and New Zealand Transport Agency Waka Kotahi. The program was implemented in 2021 and focuses on collaboration and leveraging tech.
